mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) may increase hemolysis risk in primaquine-treated patients, particularly those with G6PD deficiency, through immunosuppression and altered red blood cell vulnerability.
action: Monitor for hemolytic symptoms (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue, pallor); consider alternative antimalarial or corticosteroid if possible; ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use.
